question: Select the wrongly spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3' **i.e.** 'Arei'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **incorrect word **among the given options is **"Arei."**
 
• The **correct spelling** of this word could be **"Aerie"** or **"Aria"** or** "Area" **depending on the intended meaning.
 
• **Aerie:** A large nest of a bird of prey, especially an eagle, typically built high in a tree or on a cliff.(चील का घोंसला)
 
• **Aria: **A long, accompanied song for a solo voice, typically one in an opera or oratorio.( एक लंबा, संगीत सहित गीत)
 
• **Area****:** A region or part of a town, a country, or the world.(क्षेत्र)

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Arei'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Here are the correct versions and meanings of all the given words:
 
 
• **Affectation:** Behavior, speech, or writing that is artificial and designed to impress.(दिखावा)
 
• **Abase: **To behave in a way so as to belittle or degrade someone.( अपमानित करना)
 
• **Aesthetic:** Concerned with beauty or the appreciation of beauty.(सौंदर्य)
